control_ranker: Equal-weight mean signed threshold margin over available thresholded assays. Missing values contribute neutral margin 0. Same rank score is used to order treatment survivors.

jain_evaluation.rule: The held-out group is excluded from Receipt Gate eligibility in that fold and used only for orthogonal survivor evaluation. Published Jain group assignments and thresholds are frozen; no outcome-driven reassignment.

decision_rule: No single scalar declares CPG-001 a win. A useful result requires fewer masked declared liabilities plus non-collapsed selection yield and no material deterioration across held-out group flag rates. Report all budgets and all four folds.
authority_control: A threshold-constrained ranker using identical numeric vetoes may be reported as a selection-parity control. If it matches Receipt Gate on clean historical rows, the unique OpenLine claim narrows to independent evidence validation, immutable receiver authority, and portable receipts—not superior antibody scoring.
